title: Wu-Mei-Wan promotes ferroptosis in gallbladder cancer through STAT3 negative regulation: An integrated HPLC, proteomics, network pharmacology, and experimental validation study.
authors: Zhao, Jingwei; Shi, Liuqing; Yang, Yue; Zhu, Jiayun; Zhou, Zhe; Dong, Ping; Liu, Shilei; Yang, Ziyi; Gong, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药乌梅丸通过STAT3调控诱导胆囊癌铁死亡，虽涉及STAT3转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: As a traditional Chinese medicine, Wu-Mei-Wan (WMW) has shown promise as a second-line treatment for gallbladder cancer, but its mechanism remains to be explored. AIM OF THE STUDY: To determine the specific mechanism of WMW active ingredients (Palmatine et al.) inducing ferroptosis in gallbladder cancer (GBC) and its synergistic potential with gemcitabine. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Subcutaneous tumor in nude mice was used to analyze the combined effect of gemcitabine. The effective components into blood were identified by HPLC. Combined with proteomics, network pharmacology and bioinformatics analysis, the effective components and targets of WMW promoting ferroptosis in GBC were identified in vitro and in vivo. The anticancer effects of WMW on different GBC cell lines were evaluated by CCK-8 assay, colony formation and EdU staining. A variety of molecular biology experiments were used to explore the mechanism. RESULTS: WMW treatment enhanced the sensitivity of GBC to gemcitabine, which induced ferroptosis and effectively inhibited the malignant phenotype of GBC. Network pharmacology and blood component identification identified the key components of WMW inhibiting GBC. Palmitine and other components were identified as active components into the blood. Proteomics and molecular docking validation further revealed the STAT3-centered regulatory network in GBC cells. Molecular experiments have shown that WMW induced ferroptosis by negatively regulating downstream molecules of p-STAT3 transcription of GPX4, ACSL4, HIF1alpha, and FTH1. CONCLUSIONS: WMW induces ferroptosis in GBC through the p-STAT3 axis and enhances sensitivity to gemcitabine, suggesting the potential of WMW as a second-line therapeutic for GBC.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：作为一种传统中药，乌梅丸（WMW）在胆囊癌的二线治疗中显示出潜力，但其机制仍有待探索。研究目的：确定WMW活性成分（如巴马汀等）诱导胆囊癌（GBC）铁死亡（ferroptosis）的具体机制，及其与吉西他滨的协同潜力。材料与方法：使用裸鼠皮下肿瘤模型分析吉西他滨的联合效应。通过高效液相色谱（HPLC）鉴定入血有效成分。结合蛋白质组学、网络药理学和生物信息学分析，在体外和体内鉴定WMW促进GBC铁死亡的有效成分和靶点。通过CCK-8实验、集落形成和EdU染色评估WMW对不同GBC细胞系的抗癌效果。采用多种分子生物学实验探索其机制。结果：WMW处理增强了GBC对吉西他滨的敏感性，诱导铁死亡并有效抑制GBC的恶性表型。网络药理学和血液成分鉴定确定了WMW抑制GBC的关键成分。巴马汀及其他成分被鉴定为入血活性成分。蛋白质组学和分子对接验证进一步揭示了GBC细胞中以STAT3为中心的调控网络。分子实验表明，WMW通过负调控p-STAT3转录GPX4、ACSL4、HIF1α和FTH1的下游分子诱导铁死亡。结论：WMW通过p-STAT3轴诱导GBC铁死亡，并增强对吉西他滨的敏感性，提示WMW作为GBC二线治疗药物的潜力。
